subject: Telemetry retention & trace tiering — packaging options for Stratos Health
messages:
From: Chris Allen <chris.allen@stratoshealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry retention and tracing — initial questions

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the dashboards look promising. Before we take leadership through pricing, I need to understand a few specific items so procurement can size the PO: 

- Retention: what are the incremental costs for moving from 30 -> 90 -> 365 days for logs/metrics/traces? Is that per-GB/month or a blended banded model?
- Tracing: you mentioned an indexed trace store — is that billed per ingested span, per trace, or per query volume? Any sampling guidance?
- Dashboards: the Advanced Dashboards bundle — what's included (alerts, BI export, role-based views) and are there seat limits?
- Discounts: we have a 12-month budget cycle; what kind of volume/commit discounts do you offer on add-ons?

Also procurement wants a short write-up we can attach to the PO describing deliverables + SOC2 evidence. I can share our preliminary SOW if that helps.

Appreciate concise numbers — leadership wants to review options on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Chris Allen
Head of Platform
Stratos Health

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Allen <chris.allen@stratoshealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry retention and tracing — initial questions

Hi Chris — great to hear from you and glad the demo resonated. Below is a concise breakdown you can share with leadership / procurement. Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through the numbers.

1) Retention pricing (logs/metrics/traces):
- Base visibility tier (30 days): included with Redwood "Visibility Lite" at no additional retention fee up to 5 TB/month.
- 90 days: $0.045 per GB/month for additional retained storage beyond the included 5 TB, tiered volume discounts at 25 TB+ and 100 TB+.
- 365 days: $0.022 per GB/month beyond 5 TB, with similar volume breakpoints.
- Note: we automatically index traces/metadata for the first 90 days. Long-term cold storage for traces beyond 90d uses compressed storage and is charged at the lower band.

2) Tracing billing model:
- Ingested trace volume: priced per 100k traces ingested (default sampling 1:50 recommended for production telemetry).
- Pricing example: $120 per 100k traces ingested/month at baseline. High-cardinality workloads can be covered by our "Trace Index Add-on" which adds $60 per 100k indexed traces and includes fast query SLAs.
- Query/scan costs: included up to a free tier (30k queries/month); excess queries billed at $0.002 per query.

3) Advanced Dashboards ("Dashboards Pro"):
- Includes: multi-tenant dashboards, RBAC, scheduled exports, alerting + incident integration (PagerDuty/Slack), CSV/Parquet export, and BI API.
- Seat model: dashboard editors limited to 10 editor seats in Pro; unlimited viewer seats.
- Bundling: Dashboard Pro + Trace Index Add-on reduces combined price by 10% when purchased together.

4) Discounts & commitment options:
- 12-month commit: standard 15% on add-ons (visibility retention, trace indexing, dashboards) for committed spend >= $50k ARR.
- 24-month commit: 22%
- 36-month commit: 30% + option for annual true-up credits.
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to 1 month of retention fees for early signatures.

Suggested recommendation for Stratos Health (based on the volume numbers you shared in the demo):
- Visibility Plus bundle: 90-day retention for traces + Dashboards Pro + Trace Index Add-on with a 12-month commit at 15% discount. Estimated run-rate: ~$22k/month (assuming 35 TB/month retained + 600k traces/month).

Attachments: pricing scenarios and an exportable one-pager you can attach to the PO.
- redwood-pricing-scenarios-v3.xlsx (spreadsheet with modeled bands)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (security evidence summary)

If you want, I can also produce a short SOW paragraph that procurement can paste into the PO. When would leadership like to meet? I can carve out Tuesday 11:00–12:00 PT.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Nikhil — quick internal note before we finalize the email:

- Suggest we lead with a 12-mo recommendation but present the 24-mo as the optimal commercial path (22% discount).

- Include SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and our standard data processing addendum link.
- If they push back on the Trace Index price, propose: bundle trace index for first 3 months at list, then step to discounted rate once usage stabilizes.

Also confirm the visibility numbers in the sheet — I can update the spreadsheet with a row for the concession and a split payment schedule.
